home.title: {space} automations
home.intro: No-code "when this happens, do that" rules: when an event happens, conditions are checked and actions run in order.
home.emptyBody: E.g. post to chat when a card moves to Done, turn form answers into cards, tell n8n when a PDF is uploaded.
home.noAccessBody: Space editors see automations; space admins change them.

notFound.title: Rule not found
notFound.body: The rule may have been deleted, or you cannot see it.

editor.name: Rule name
editor.tableValuesHint: Empty fields are not written. Choices match by label, people by email or name; values that do not fit are skipped.
editor.noConditions: No conditions: actions run every time the trigger fires.
editor.templateHint: Use "Add a variable" to put a value from the event.
editor.testStarted: Ran with a sample event; see the history
editor.deleteBody: The rule and its run history are deleted for good.
editor.stoppedNotice: This rule was stopped after {count} failed runs in a row. Fix the problem and save it again with "On".
editor.hookHint: Every request that posts JSON here triggers the rule; body fields are read as body.field. At most 60 requests a minute.
editor.signingHint: Outgoing requests are signed with the X-Crewhall-Signature header (sha256 HMAC); the receiver checks it with this secret.

runs.emptyBody: Each run shows here, when the trigger fires or with "Try now".

runErrors.rule_disabled: Did not run because the rule is off.
runErrors.module_disabled: Did not run because automations are off in the organization.
runErrors.automation_owner_inactive: The rule's owner left the organization; an admin needs to save the rule again.

tables.row_created.name: Row added to a table
tables.row_created.desc: When a row is added to the chosen table (by hand, from a form, by import or by another rule).

tables.row_updated.name: Table row changed
tables.row_updated.desc: When a value of a row in the chosen table changes; with a field chosen, only when that field changes.

boards.card_moved.name: Card moved
boards.card_moved.desc: When a card on the chosen board moves to another column.

forms.response_submitted.name: Form answered
forms.response_submitted.desc: Each time the chosen form gets an answer. Answers are read as answers.field_id.

drive.file_uploaded.name: File uploaded
drive.file_uploaded.desc: When a file or a new version is uploaded to the space (or the chosen folder).

webhook.received.name: Webhook received
webhook.received.desc: When a request comes to the rule's own address (CI, monitoring, n8n…).

calendar.event_upcoming.name: Event coming up
calendar.event_upcoming.desc: When an event of the space calendar is the chosen time away (every occurrence of a recurring event).

tables.create_row.name: Add a table row
tables.create_row.desc: Adds a row to the chosen table with fields filled from templates.

tables.update_row.name: Update a table row
tables.update_row.desc: Updates the chosen fields of the row with the given id from templates.

chat.post.name: Post to chat
chat.post.desc: Posts a message to the chosen chat in the rule's name.

boards.create_card.name: Open a card
boards.create_card.desc: Opens a new card in a column of the chosen board.

notify.users.name: Send a notification
notify.users.desc: The chosen people get a notification.

webhook.send.name: Send a webhook
webhook.send.desc: Sends the event as signed JSON to an outside address.

ai.step.name: AI step
ai.step.desc: Gives the instruction with the event to the organization's model; later steps can use the answer as this step's text output.

notifications.disabled: {name} failed {count} times in a row and was stopped

board.intro: Rules that start from this board. Rules are built on the space's Automations page: post to chat, notify people or call a webhook when a card moves.
board.none: No rules for this board yet.
board.off: Automations are off in this organization.
